name: Zohra Tourville

bio.statement: The Governor's office announced in July 2026 that Zohra Bakhtary Tourville would be appointed to the Washington County Circuit Court.
bio.excerpt: Governor Tina Kotek announced today that she will appoint Zohra Bakhtary Tourville to the Washington County Circuit Court.

source.publisher: Oregon Governor's Office

bio.statement: The Governor's office says Tourville fills the vacancy created by the retirement of Judge Theodore Sims.
bio.excerpt: Judge Bakhtary Tourville will fill the vacancy created by the retirement of Judge Theodore Sims.

source.publisher: Oregon Governor's Office
